blocks.text: Committee interlock   The Chief Risk Officer chairs the Enterprise Risk Committee. The Data Protection Officer, the VP Information Security and the Director of Third-Party Risk hold standing membership. Escalations from the divisions feed the committee on a monthly cycle, with material items routed to the Board Risk Committee.
